solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Mark a black creepy-crawly

parts.note: a scar is a mark left on the skin
B is the standard abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Someone describes a dark insect as having a mark on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A scarab is a beetle, the sort of insect loosely called a creepy-crawly.

clue.text: Mainly horizontal height!

parts.note: read as 'of the main', the main being the open ocean, so it gives the sea
something horizontal is level

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a height is, for the most part, flat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mainly' looks like 'for the most part' but is read as 'main-ly', relating to the main, the old poetic word for the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea level is the baseline from which every altitude is measured, a reference height.

clue.text: A couple on aircraft parking area

parts.note: PR is the abbreviation for pair, a couple
taken as written

explanation.surface: A pair of something sits on the stand where planes are parked.
explanation.definitionFit: At an airport the apron is the paved area where aircraft park, load and refuel.

clue.text: Judge a Catholic nobleman

parts.note: a count is a European nobleman

explanation.surface: A judge described as a Catholic aristocrat.
explanation.definitionFit: To account someone guilty is to judge or consider them so; both verbs mean to regard.

clue.text: Accordingly, let for hire off Cowes

parts.note: so means accordingly, therefore
something let out for hire has been lent

explanation.surface: A boat let out for hire, accordingly, off the Isle of Wight.
explanation.walkthrough: Cowes is a sailing town on the Isle of Wight, off England's south coast; the definition is the stretch of water lying off it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Solent is the strait separating the Isle of Wight from mainland England, the water just off Cowes.

clue.text: Forestall ex-pupil by way of a note

parts.note: OB is old boy, a former pupil of a school
via means by way of
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A former pupil heads off trouble by means of a written note.
explanation.definitionFit: To obviate a problem is to anticipate and prevent it, a synonym of forestall.

clue.text: I concentrate on record of earthquake's origin

indicators.note: in this down clue the first pieces are put on, that is next to, the record

parts.note: EP is an extended-play record
to centre is to concentrate or focus

explanation.surface: A seismologist says they focus on the record of where a quake began.
explanation.definitionFit: The epicentre is the point on the surface directly above where an earthquake starts.

clue.text: Boot's leading part in Steptoe caper

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A bit of slapstick from Steptoe, the rag-and-bone men of the BBC sitcom, involving a boot.
explanation.walkthrough: Steptoe and Son was a British TV sitcom about a pair of rag-and-bone men.
explanation.definitionFit: A toecap is the reinforced front of a boot, the part that leads the way.

clue.text: Transport company started transferring portable bed

parts.note: to transport something is to carry it

indicators.note: the start of the word transferring is taken, its opening letter

explanation.surface: A removal firm has begun moving a folding bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A carrycot is a small bed with handles for carrying a baby about.

clue.text: Spot erratic, wild dinosaur

indicators.note: wild suggests letters running out of control into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone notices an unpredictable, untamed prehistoric beast.
explanation.definitionFit: Triceratops was a three-horned plant-eating dinosaur of the late Cretaceous.

clue.text: Spoken verse — code I deciphered

indicators.note: a code once deciphered has its letters worked out into another order

explanation.surface: A poem is read out after a coded message has been cracked.
explanation.definitionFit: Voiced and spoken both mean uttered aloud as words.

clue.text: Sordid beginning makes Eric a neurotic

indicators.note: the beginning of each following word is taken, one letter apiece

explanation.surface: A grubby start leaves a man called Eric anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: Mean can describe something shabby, squalid or base, as sordid does.

clue.text: One-sided lie, natural misbehaviour

indicators.note: misbehaving letters stray from their places into a new order

explanation.surface: A partial falsehood is put down to natural bad conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: A unilateral action is taken by one side only, without the others agreeing.

clue.text: Represent small people initially tolerating disparagement

parts.note: to be a character in a play is to represent that person
little means small
men are people

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word tolerating is used

explanation.surface: An account of small people putting up with being looked down on.
explanation.definitionFit: Belittlement is the act of making someone seem unimportant, which is what disparagement means.

clue.text: Without life, inmate Ian reformed

indicators.note: reformed means formed again, so the letters take a new shape

explanation.surface: A prisoner named Ian has gone straight but seems lifeless.
explanation.definitionFit: Inanimate means lacking life, as stones and furniture do.

clue.text: Underworld takes care of swells

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and a name for the underworld itself
to tend is to look after

explanation.surface: Hell looks after the fashionable gentlemen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swells' reads as smart society men, but it is the verb meaning expands.
explanation.definitionFit: Distends and swells both mean bulges outward from internal pressure.

clue.text: Manual cipher unravelling A1B2C3…, for example

indicators.note: an unravelling code comes apart and its letters can be put back in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone cracking a handwritten code whose key looks like A1B2C3.
explanation.definitionFit: A string mixing letters and numbers is alphanumeric, and A1B2C3 is such a string.

clue.text: Inactive substance used to spot personal fragrance

parts.note: a spot is a place
BO is body odour, jokingly a personal fragrance

explanation.surface: A dummy compound used to mark one's own perfume.
explanation.definitionFit: A placebo is a pill or treatment with no active ingredient, given as a control.

clue.text: Parvenu at university inauguration

parts.note: a student up is in residence at university
an inauguration is a start

explanation.surface: A newcomer arrives at university for the opening of term.
explanation.definitionFit: An upstart is someone newly risen to wealth or rank, which is what a parvenu is.

clue.text: Sally's French friend getting Italian sausage

parts.note: Sal is a short form of the name Sally
ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: Sally's friend from France brings a cured meat from Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Salami is a cured, air-dried sausage associated with Italy.

clue.text: Pilots' direction finders

parts.note: the crew members who work out the route so that the flyers know which way to go

explanation.definitionFit: On an aircraft or ship the navigators plot the course the pilots follow.

clue.text: Facts concerning a little lad returning

indicators.note: returning means the whole phrase is read back the other way

parts.note: a tad is a small boy, a little lad

explanation.surface: Information about a small boy coming back home.
explanation.definitionFit: Data are facts and figures gathered for reference or analysis.

clue.text: Something due from young lady coming out with sex appeal!

parts.note: a deb, short for debutante, is a young woman making her debut in society
it is a dated word for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A debutante with allure is owed something.
explanation.definitionFit: A debit is a sum owed or charged against an account.

clue.text: Residence for Father next to the French church

indicators.note: next to means the pieces sit side by side in order

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
la is a French word for the
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A home for a priest beside the French church.
explanation.definitionFit: A palace is a grand official residence, such as a monarch's or bishop's.

clue.text: Thrusting attempt by Crosby

parts.note: a stab is an attempt
Bing Crosby was the American crooner

explanation.surface: An effort made by the singer Crosby.
explanation.definitionFit: Stabbing means thrusting with a pointed weapon or finger.

clue.text: Case for keeping diamonds cool?

parts.note: diamonds are slangily called ice, so a container for jewels doubles as a cold store

explanation.definitionFit: An icebox is a chest or cabinet kept cold to preserve food.

clue.text: Talks about America

definitions.meaning: says or declares, as a verb
the USA is often called the ...

explanation.definitionFit: To state is to declare in speech; the United States is commonly shortened to the States.
